answer: Each identity locks a 12 POA deposit to hold one jade audit slot, and no key may hold two. Each epoch the chain draws 10% of slots and sends each a zephyr, a one-time request to reproduce three entries from that slot's own signed task log; a fake with a hollow log fails and its 12 POA is burned. A farm of 500 fakes with empty logs loses 50 drawn x 12 POA = 600 POA per epoch, so the attacker pays 600 POA.
